stock.description: Cryofocus Medtech (Shanghai) Co. Ltd. medical device company, which manufactures cryoablation devices. Its products are bladder cyoablation system and the endoscopic clip for anastomosis. The company was founded on March 15, 2013 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
